title: The CSAF Godot Collection is live: 21 addon packs in one project
html:
The CSAF Godot Collection is live: all 21 of our paid Godot 4.7 addon packs in one download, 1,127 presets for 2D games, in one project that opens and plays. New packs join it on the day they launch, at no extra cost.

What it does

  • A browser with one card per addon. Enter opens that pack's own demo, and F10 comes back from any of them.
  • The World: one town at dusk with 18 of the addons running at once. A traveller walks through rain under Lantern's sky, past Gnomon's shadows and through Glimpse's cutouts, breaks a Smithereens crate, opens a Threshold door that throws a real light on the road, and draws a Cartography map as he goes. It ships as source, so you can read how they combine.
  • The addons are the same files as the single packs. Copy one or all of them into your game. None depends on another.

Tested

  • All 21 addons in one project under Forward+ and Compatibility: 2256 frames from the shipped zip, zero engine errors.
  • Every demo opened through the browser by keys, mouse and code and closed again under both renderers, then the whole walk through The World.
  • 11 attacks, including every scene of all the addons opened one at a time in a blank project under a path with spaces and non Latin characters, a renamed addon folder, and every demo opened twice in a row; 128 Readme claims checked against the shipped files and the live pages.
  • The large test found two limits the single packs did not. Opening all 60 Fathom presets one after another in one run reached about 900 MB of textures, and Vulkan on our test machine then began refusing buffers; the call that clears the cache answers it, and the Readme says so.
  • The second is a crash. Under Compatibility, 64 Cartography and Fogbank scenes alive at once crashed the engine, every time. 56 ran clean, one of each is fine, and Forward+ ran 96. Raising rendering/gl_compatibility/item_buffer_size to 131072 moved the crash to between 80 and 96 scenes. We have not measured whether plain engine scenes do the same, so we are not calling it an engine bug. The store page says this today; the Readme gets the same line at the next rebuild.

Where this line stands: 23 Godot packs live from this studio, 1 purchase so far (read from the store the day this went live).

Disclosure: the scripts, shaders and demos were written with AI; the demo art comes from our own generated sets, and the cover is a generated illustration.
